system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Retrieves complete vaccination history for a registered animal including all past vaccinations, dates, and vaccines used.. my livestock_id is None.

function.name: livestock_get_vaccination_history
function.description: Retrieves complete vaccination history for a registered animal including all past vaccinations, dates, and vaccines used. Requires session_token. Does NOT book new vaccinations. Fails if livestock_id is invalid or no history exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.
